title: ManagerObjectivePlan
description: Bounded manager objective plan artifact generated by the Phase 23 AI Manager Objective Planner. In --mock mode this is a deterministic scaffold; live model calls are disabled unless both --allow-model-call and AGENT_MANAGER_AI_ENABLE_MODEL_CALLS=1 are present.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this manager objective plan format.

feature_id.description: Feature identifier derived from the source feature brief title slug.

source_feature_brief_path.description: Path to the FEATURE_BRIEF.json that this plan is based on.

source_architecture_proposal_path.description: Path to the ARCHITECTURE_PROPOSAL.json that this plan references.

title.description: Short descriptive title for the manager objective plan.

manager_plan_status.description: Current status of the manager objective plan.

objective_id.description: Unique identifier for this objective within the feature scope.

objective_summary.description: Concise summary of the objective to be achieved.

selected_architecture_summary.description: Summary of the selected architecture from the Phase 22 proposal.

allowed_files.description: Files explicitly allowed to be modified during implementation.

acceptance_criteria.description: Acceptance criteria that must be met.

rollback_plan.description: Plan for rolling back changes if implementation fails.

dependencies.description: Dependencies required before implementation can begin.

constraints.description: Constraints that apply to the implementation.

out_of_scope.description: Items explicitly out of scope for this objective.

questions_for_human.description: Questions that require human review or clarification.

ready_for_openhands_manual_gate.description: Whether this plan is ready for OpenHands manual gate review.

model_call_allowed.description: Whether a model call was allowed during generation.

model_called.description: Whether a live model was called during generation.

source_writes_performed.description: Whether source writes to target project repos were performed.

openhands_executed.description: Whether OpenHands was executed during generation.

coder_task_executed.description: Whether a coder task was executed during generation.

apply_performed.description: Whether an apply operation was performed.

pr_created.description: Whether a pull request was created.
